Java API

language.execution

Host-neutral execution contracts and loading primitives for compiled LPC programs.

Detailed Javadoc references open in a new tab.

Classes and interfaces

LPCExecution
Host-neutral invocation boundary for a materialized LPC object.
LPCExecutionOptions
Configuration options for the host-facing LPC execution runtime.
LPCExecutionOptions.Builder
LPCLoadResult
Result wrapper for loading LPC objects, allowing callers to handle failures gracefully.
LPCObjectHandle
A stable LPC object identity and the execution boundary through which it is invoked.
LPCObjectInspection
Snapshot of host-visible state for a loaded LPC object.
LPCObjectInspection.FieldValue
LPCObjectInspection.MethodSignature
LPCObjectLoadObserver
Observes host-side LPC object load and compile attempts for diagnostics.
LPCProgramRevision
One linked version of an LPC source program, independent of any live object executing it.
LPCRuntimeClassLoader
Defines and reuses generated LPC classes within one JVM class-loading generation.
LPCRuntimeException
Signals failures while compiling or instantiating LPC objects for a runtime instance.
